Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace – metering & fulfillment alignment (post-call)

Hi Sarah — attaching the entitlement mapping and a short technical note on metering events. TL;DR: we support two metering SKUs for your account: 

1) ACME-seat-monthly: increments when a user is provisioned and active within Acme's tenant for a month.
2) ACME-token-usage: increments per 1,000 model tokens consumed (aggregated at account level).

Key implementation notes:
- We emit Marketplace MeterUsage events via the AWS metering API every 6 hours (near real-time SLA).
- For seat-based tiers we also support a daily reconciliation push if you prefer snapshots over incremental deltas.
- If you want a delayed billing start, we can set an internal activation flag (billing suppressed) and flip it on the marketplace entitlement submission date — need AWS approval for the suppressed-billing flow.

Attachment: rw_entitlement_map_v1.xlsx (contains sample mapping with SKUs and invoice descriptions)

Sample snippet from the mapping (for reference):
- Enterprise (Tier 3) -> ACME-seat-monthly -> 100 seats included, overage per seat billed monthly
- Growth (Tier 2) -> ACME-token-usage -> include 10M tokens / month, overage per 1k tokens

Let me know if you want the metering cadence hardened to hourly instead of 6 hours; that trades off slightly higher API throughput for reduced exposure to reconciliation differences.

Thanks,
Dev
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: rw_entitlement_map_v1.xlsx)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>

Thanks — the mapping looks sensible. A few procurement comments on the redline (details in the attached PDF):
- We need a clause that guarantees a 30-day notice before any changes to metering definitions that would affect pricing.
- For billing start we will accept a deferred start if the vendor confirms: (a) explicit Docusign acceptance, and (b) a marketplace activation date in writing.

Attached our annotated redline: acme_contract_redline_20261001.pdf (we've highlighted the metering and billing sections). Once legal signs off we will route for PO issuance.

Can you confirm when Redwood will submit the fulfillment artifacts to AWS? If you can submit by Oct 4 we can aim for Oct 15 listing live.

Sarah
